helpCard.title: {recipientFirstName} can''t remember the code?
helpCard.tip1: **Check she has {shipperFirstName}.** {recipientFirstName} can search her recent WhatsApp or SMS.
helpCard.tip2: **Call {shipperFirstName} together.** She can resend the code or generate a new one if needed.
helpCard.tip3: **3 failed attempts** will lock the entry for 15 minutes for security reasons.
